title: Made the site for ...
intro.description: Over the past three years, I traced our family branch’s migration since the Suro Kingdom, collecting precious stories along the way. This online archive preserves oral histories of ethnic Koreans in China and Korean families separated by warfare, documenting their 20th-century lives, migrations, and family separations. It aims to preserve personal memories and connect lived experiences with overlooked local history. All interviews were recorded with consent.

thanks.title: Made it possible by ...
thanks.description: I wish to thank all interviewees for generously contributing their firsthand testimonies and granting permission to record and archive their narratives. I am grateful to my mother for accompanying me across much of this journey, and to my grandfather, whose recollections first helped me map out the backbone of these histories. May this website mark these small but significant stories, so that we may learn how history leaves its traces on ordinary people like us.
